name: FallingText-TS-TW
title: Falling Text
blurb: Words tumble and bounce with physics gravity when triggered, draggable with the…
description: Renders text as individual words that simulate physics using Matter.js. Words fall with gravity, collide with boundaries, and respond to mouse dragging. Trigger modes: auto, scroll, click, or hover.
use_when: An interactive hero section needs eye-catching motion that feels tactile and responds to user input.
avoid_when: Low-end devices or when content must remain static and readable — the physics simulation runs continuously.
a11y: Text starts rendered as DOM elements but repositioned by canvas physics simulation. Not easily accessible to screen readers during animation.
